signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Define and maintain a clear product roadmap aligned to FSA’s mission, milestones, and contract objectives using the Focus Delivery Framework Apply structured prioritization…
Turn vendor team pain points, release data, and stakeholder goals into epics, user stories, and clear acceptance criteria
Define success measures for test coverage, release velocity, defect escape rate, and pipeline reliability
Partner with engineering leads on AWS architecture, CI/CD pipelines, test automation strategy, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code, and make informed tradeoffs without prescribing…
Own the backlog for developer self-service tools (test data generation, pipeline status, environment readiness) used by vendor teams and government stakeholders
Provide expert knowledge and insights in accounting practices
Utilize proficiency in accounting software and technology solutions, including experience with system conversions and integrations
Demonstrate organizational and leadership skills, with the ability to guide stakeholders through complex public policy implementation and business processes
Wield exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders
Assist in the development and review of program documentation, training content, and manuals
Determine user needs and business requirements through stakeholder interviews and user research, often in collaboration with designer/researchers
Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap showing how increments of working software will be delivered to achieve business goals
Define user flows, system behavior, and other product specifications that enable team members to design and build working software
Define quarterly or program increment goals to establish near- and mid-term milestones for delivering working software
Iterate on the product vision, strategy, and roadmap as the team learns from feedback
Define the vision, goals, and measures of success for the products and services you manage
Work with designers, business analysts, and technical leads to discover and synthesize market research, user needs, business requirements, and technical approaches
Define the direction, scope, and priority of projects, from high-level initiatives to specific features, user stories, and business metrics
Work closely with cross-functional teams to develop and ship projects
Proactively socialize, iterate on, and build buy-in for product initiatives with the team, government partners, and other contractors
